Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `67fc80fc92782d8b25e8a5e063cf671dbfe8ea1d` on `orchestrator/project-3601` (matches integration-branch metadata).

Clarification mapping: no Q1+ were asked; `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` adds no extra scope beyond the issue body.

Automation / wiring:
- Change type: modify existing prompt assets only.
- Scheduler / PR-push entry point: none.
- New supervisor: none.
- DB gate / contract changes: N/A.
- `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`: no entry needed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends the existing reviewer-checklist lens contract, the existing judge numbered rubric, and the existing `mode-judge` prompt-assembly mirror path
Scope-mode justification: This stays within the requested Theme A prompt-only change. The only extra file beyond the issue’s two named paths is `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt`, which is the active assembled runtime mirror for shell-rendered judge prompts, so updating it is part of delivering the same requested criteria rather than broadening scope. If the new checklist lens makes the existing “eighth lens” prose self-contradictory, any wording cleanup should stay minimal and local in that same file. That keeps the change aligned with §6 priorities: correctness and operational clarity over a narrowly literal but incomplete edit.

Files likely to change:
- `prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt`
  - Insert `IMPLICIT-EXECUTION & TRUST-BOUNDARY RISKS` immediately after `NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY`.
  - Keep the new lens additive and prose-based, with explicit `Emit NONE` guidance.
  - If needed, make only the smallest count/format wording touch-up elsewhere in this same file so the new lens does not conflict with the existing TASK_GAP instructions.
- `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
  - Append criteria 6 and 7 after the existing 5-item evaluation list.
  - Preserve criteria 1-5 verbatim.
- `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt`
  - Mirror the same criteria 6 and 7 so shell-rendered / assembled judge prompts match the direct prompt file.

Conflicts noted:
- `prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt` currently describes `TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS` as the eighth lens, so the request to add a new “8th lens” after `NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY` is numerically inconsistent with the current prompt text.
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh` resolves `prompts/mode-judge.txt` to `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` when `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true`, so changing only `prompts/mode-judge.txt` would leave the active assembled runtime prompt stale.

Prompt blocks to extend:
- Reviewer checklist lens:
  - Add the new heading after `NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY`.
  - Constrain it to the approved surfaces only: workflow YAML, `.claude/*`, MCP config, `scripts/*` entry points, env-var defaults, and subprocess / watcher registration.
  - Cover the planned trust-boundary patterns: implicit execution without a documented gate, state-scope creep, and declared-vs-effective capability gaps.
  - Tell reviewers to emit `NONE` when the diff does not touch those surfaces or when touched surfaces are already properly gated.
  - Keep it using the existing finding contract style; do not introduce a new output schema.
- Judge criteria:
  - Add criterion 6 for implicit execution without the corresponding gate / kill switch / invocation guard.
  - Add criterion 7 for declared-vs-effective scope drift.
  - Append only; do not rewrite or renumber the first five criteria.
- Template parity:
  - Keep `prompts/mode-judge.txt` and `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` text-aligned for the two new criteria.

Data structures affected:
- Reviewer output remains plain text with the same finding fields (`File`, `Line or code reference`, `Problem`, `Why it fails at runtime`, `SEVERITY`, `ISSUE_CONFIDENCE`).
- `TASK_GAP` format remains unchanged.
- Judge JSON output contract remains unchanged.
- No new env vars, labels, schemas, or identifiers.

API/interface changes:
- Internal prompt-contract change only.
- Reviewer prompt gains one new lens heading.
- Judge prompt gains two new evaluation checks.
- No workflow input/output, CLI, API, or consumer-facing contract changes.

Data flow:
- Direct prompt readers/tests: `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
- Shell/workflow path: `prompts/mode-judge.txt` -> `scripts/render_prompt.sh` -> `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` -> assembled judge prompt
- Result: both judge prompt copies must carry the same new criteria.

Failure modes:
- If the new reviewer lens adds another literal `WHAT TO FLAG` / `WHAT NOT TO FLAG` pair, the existing checklist contract test’s marker counts will break; use prose guidance plus `Emit NONE` instead.
- If `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` is not updated, runtime judge prompts will miss criteria 6 and 7 even if `prompts/mode-judge.txt` looks correct on disk.
- If the checklist’s count-specific prose is left contradictory, reviewers may get mixed instructions about whether the new lens uses standard findings or TASK_GAP handling.

Risks and edge cases:
- Keep the reviewer lens tightly limited to the approved trust-boundary surfaces; do not let it turn into a general security/docs lens.
- Do not rename or remove any existing heading, role line, identifier, or output-contract text.
- Do not broaden this phase into `prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt`, other judge-family prompts, workflows, docs, tests, or consumer wrappers.
- If count-word cleanup is needed in `prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt`, keep it surgical and leave `TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS` plus its `TASK_GAP` schema intact.

Testing considerations:
- Re-read `prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt` and confirm the order is:
  - `NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY`
  - `IMPLICIT-EXECUTION & TRUST-BOUNDARY RISKS`
  - `TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS`
- Confirm the new reviewer lens explicitly says to emit `NONE` when nothing actionable is present.
- Confirm the reviewer lens names only the approved surfaces from the plan.
- Re-read `prompts/mode-judge.txt` and `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` to confirm criteria 1-5 are unchanged and 6-7 are appended in order.
- Sanity-check that the checklist still has only seven literal `WHAT TO FLAG` and seven literal `WHAT NOT TO FLAG` markers if tests remain untouched.
- Optional read-only sanity check: render `prompts/mode-judge.txt` through the shell wrapper with the assembled path enabled to confirm the runtime prompt includes criteria 6 and 7.

Assumptions / missing-context notes:
- Treat `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt` as an internal runtime mirror, not a consumer-facing workflow template.
- The issue does not explicitly say whether tiny count-word fixes outside the insertion point are allowed; assume they are permitted only if needed to avoid a contradictory prompt contract, otherwise keep the change append-only.

PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: The requested new “8th lens” conflicts with the checklist’s current numbering of `TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS`; any consistency fix should stay minimal and local.
PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: The assembled runtime judge path uses `prompts/_templates/mode-judge.txt`, so editing only `prompts/mode-judge.txt` would be incomplete.
STATUS: CLEAR
